I am having this exact same problem, and it has made Godot very frustrating. Completely freeze/crashing after playing animation for 0.5-1.5 sec. I am using 4.4 beta 1.
I have tested 4.3 stable and have the same crash. 

I can scroll though the animation manually, but if I push Play it will freeze after playing a second. I have to force close the Editor.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8ffcd279-da99-4977-903c-125cc26e9a4e

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/91ef1f9b-8a13-44ae-b304-dacc900c065d

The original poster didn't include a MRP. I am including one here. As well, I have taken the time to show videos of it manually scrolling and then playing the animation. Please help with this.

MRP:

[anim.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18580314/anim.zip)

I have done further testing. This problem only happens when using Forward+. If I switch to Compatible mode it will not crash, but other things don't operate as expected.

I checked NVidia and my GPU is fully supported for Vulkan 1.4 
I have the GeForce RTX laptop: GeForce RTX 4090. Very high end.

I am also getting the crash with GPUParticles2D nodes in Forward+

Can't reproduce sadly.

Godot v4.3.stable - Windows 10.0.19045 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-6700K CPU @ 4.00GHz (8 Threads)
@AeioMuch, thank you for testing.  I hope more people can try to test it because, something is definitely wrong and more than one person is experiencing it.

@AeioMuch, what is the NVidia driver version do you have installed? it should be in the 500 range. The latest is 572.16.

Also, here is a[ post of another person with the same experience](https://forum.godotengine.org/t/forward-mode-freezes-godot-4-editor-after-gpuparticles2d-editing/94319). (Actually, if you search "Forward+ Godot freeze", many posts pop up)
I am sure this is related. There is something in the NVidia updates that are causing this.
He mentions "For me that was: 552.44 which installed Vulkan 1.3.277"

> [@AeioMuch](https://github.com/AeioMuch), what is the NVidia driver version do you have installed? it should be in the 500 range. The latest is 572.16.
> 
> Also, here is a[ post of another person with the same experience](https://forum.godotengine.org/t/forward-mode-freezes-godot-4-editor-after-gpuparticles2d-editing/94319). I am sure this is related. There is something in the NVidia updates that are causing this. He mentions "For me that was: 552.44 which installed Vulkan 1.3.277"

You can see my driver version above where I share my system info (it's the 5 last numbers), i.e. I have 566.36.
Vulkan Instance Version is 1.4.303
Vulkan Api Version is 1.3.289
I don't use the latest driver version 572.16 because it is broken.

I wonder what the missing piece is that is causing some users to freeze using Forward+. I do know that it started when some users updated the NVidia driver installing Vulkan 1.3.277. I hope there is a solution. Of course, more people are going to have to reproduce this.
In this case the missing piece is likely the NVIDIA drivers?

Hi, I made an account just to chime in. I am also experiencing freezes when just hovering over any of the animation buttons while any animation is playing.

I'm working with 2 monitors running at different refresh rates. My primary screen at 240Hz and the secondary at 59.95Hz. When playing an animation and hovering over a button the tooltip spawns, causing a heavy stutter to occur. This happens on both monitors, but only freezes on the slower secondary screen. I have to note here that Windows updated my machine and now freezes are suddenly less frequent than before. But I can still trigger them after a few attempts:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b73079c7-d981-4c0e-83f9-2231ffd685cc

_System Info:
Godot v4.4.beta3 - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900H (20 threads)
*Using Nvidia Driver 566.36, as 572.24 is currently bugged._

Godot does not log this. No warning or error is printed to the console (even with --verbose) and Windows logs this application freeze as "HangType: Unknown".

When digging into older related issues I found #85409, in which @TokageItLab mentions:

> "... This cause is the thread gets clogged up when the ToolTip appears during animation playback." 

My guess is that this thread is still getting clogged up enough to eventually freeze the engine...

**Workaround:**
Use the A/S/D shortcut keys instead to avoid the buttons altogether, animations play buttery smooth too as a bonus.
As there is no way to disable the tooltips (that I know of), save often. Nothing is more frustrating than forgetting not to move the cursor away from the play animation button and the freeze inducing tooltip spawning, destroying all the progress you made...

Edit:
An alternative workaround is to enable Single Window Mode in the engine settings. I have not encountered a single stutter or freeze yet with it enabled. Animations now play smoothly, but the downside is that the new game embedding function or detaching the script editor does not work.

After updating to Nvidia's latest drivers I tried to see if anything had changed regarding this issue. I found out that the problem has something to do with the way windows and tooltips are created with Multi-Window enabled. The stuttering when a tooltip or window spawns also happens even when an animation isn't playing, but only seems to actually freeze the engine when one is playing.

Re-reading the comments in #85409 I somehow missed that @Calinou mentioned to check if the same issue happens when Update Continously is enabled. So I went ahead and enabled it and tried to make it freeze again, and it did for a few times with no errors. 
But on one occasion I got it to freeze for a few seconds and then responding again, this time with some hopefully useful errors in the output tab:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/27090367-4fe3-419b-b92d-e35a8b8c472a)

These are the errors after going through the error spam:
```
- ERROR: (326) platform/windows/display_server_windows.cpp:3825 - Parameter "hicon" is null.
- ERROR: platform/windows/display_server_windows.cpp:4454 - Unexpected window message 0x82 received for window we cannot recognize in our collection; sequence error.
- ERROR: Failed to create Windows OS window.
- ERROR: Failed to create sub window.
- ERROR: scene/main/window.cpp:674 - Condition "window_id == DisplayServer::INVALID_WINDOW_ID" is true.
- ERROR: platform/windows/display_server_windows.cpp:1960 - Condition "!windows.has(p_window)" is true. Returning: -1
```

### How to (reliably?) reproduce:

1. Create project using Forward+, enable Update Continously and disable Single Window mode (if set) in the editor settings
2. Create a simple animation
3. Set animation to looping and play
4. Repeatedly spawn any window, subwindow or tooltip while the animation is playing until either errors occur or engine freezes

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0fe1980f-9a83-4d75-b89d-e5178cb9ce09

I am hoping others can try this method to see if they get the same errors as I do.

**Edit**
This bug is reproducible in v4.0 stable using the above method. After freezing it 7 times I got it to respond only once after a long stutter (each attempt to freeze takes anywhere from 10 seconds to 10 minutes). No errors are produced or shown in the verbose log. The godot icon in the titlebar turns into the default windows program icon and the contents of each dropdown menu disappear. Spawning any tooltip in this state causes a freeze.
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/523fe871-6181-482f-8f47-da58c71a96a8)

Trying to recreate the issue on Linux does not yield a similar error message or crash, which is not surprising since it looks to be Windows-specific, but following the above method of turning on the looping animation and panning across the menu bar menus does result in significant stuttering of the playing animation and the menus appearing themselves. This occurs both with and without continuous update mode enabled.
